title: Surgical Process Analyst
description: Description The Surgical Process Analyst provides dedicated consistent analytical support to the Division of Hospital Surgical Services and/or the OPC's. The Surgical Process Analyst works collaboratively with multiple groups within the Mayo system and serves as a point of contact. The Surgical Process Analyst develops or enhances process and electronic tools used to analyze trends, identify opportunities and monitors continuous improvement activities related to Surgical Services.
